batting.name: AJ Finch
batting.dismissal: c UT Yadav b M Morkel

batting.name: AP Tare
batting.dismissal: c UT Yadav b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b M Morkel

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c Harbhajan Singh b CJ Anderson

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c AT Rayudu b JJ Bumrah

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b Harbhajan Singh

balls.text: a bit of air, drops down on the perfect length for Anderson to muscle away for another big six over wide long-on, and reach his half-century off the last ball of the innings
down the track, driven to long-on, and he'll end this innings unbeaten on 98
shot! That's fired in flat and full outside off, and he slices it away cleanly to the deep point boundary
full again, swiped to deep midwicket

Another drop. Down the track, Shakib followed him with a yorker fired at his feet. Swung at it, picked out Morne running to his right from deep backward square leg, and he dived low to his right and couldn't hold on
full-toss on off stump, and Anderson clears his front leg, sinks to one knee, and swats it away powerfully over deep midwicket
full outside off, jabbed down to long-off
bouncer now, digs it in, gets it up to shoulder height, in that awkward area outside off, can't connect with the pull
full and wide, Rohit looks to slog it over midwicket, ends up bottom-edging it into the ground, bounces up to keeper, jogging to his right
full on off stump, Rohit moves his front leg out of the way and simply times the ball over the long-off boundary. Just a full, free swing of his arms
length ball outside off, Anderson clears his front leg and launches it high over long-off
full and flat outside off, driven to sweeper cover
boom. That was fired in again, but it's too full, low full-toss, and he backed away and made enough swinging room to hit it hard over the bowler and drill it between long-on and long-off
full, in the blockhole, following the batsman as he clears his leg to hit over the leg side, smacks Anderson on the foot
fired in again, straighter this time, driven down to long-onflat and full outside off, looks for the inside-out drive, hits it hard and straight to the bowler

tossed up outside off, and Rohit drives powerfully into the gap between sweeper cover and long-off. Russell, sprinting in from sweeper cover, throws himself to his right to stop it but can only deflect it into the ropes
that's a flat, fast yorker-length wide that almost hits the return crease outside off
on the pads, worked away to deep midwicket
and again, except it isn't as full as the previous ball, and it allows him to get under the ball and get the elevation to easily clear the boundary at deep square leg
this one's angled in towards leg stump, and he clears his front leg and sweeps it hard to the forward square leg boundary
dropped. Down the track comes Rohit, swings wildly across the line. This one's the legbreak, and the edge pops straight out of Uthappa's gloves
down the track now, makes room as he comes at the bowler, slaps this off-stump ball down to long-off
length ball, turns in towards off and middle, clipped away towards deep midwicket
very full on leg stump, swiped away to deep midwicket
tossed up, angled in towards middle stump. Clears his front leg and sweeps it towards deep square leg
tossed up outside off, reaches out and drives sweetly to the left of the diving Manish Pandey at short extra cover
down the track, drives hard to cover point

full on off stump, and that is a terrible drop from Russell at deep midwicket. Anderson swung hard at it, hit it in the air, with the turn, and hit it straight to the fielder, who only had to cup his hands in front of his body to catch the ball, but it was straight in and out

whatashot! Another length ball, this time wide outside off, but even though there was width on offer he really had to time that brilliantly to beat third man. Simply moved forward, towards the ball, and sliced through the line with an open bat face to send it rocketing away to the right of the fielder
another length ball, angling into middle stump, and Rohit clears his front leg again and swats it high over wide long-on
length ball outside off, makes a bit of room, and absolutely creams that, flat-batting it in the air, into the gap to the right of extra cover and the left of long-off

length ball on middle stump, clears his front leg and has a big swing at it, doesn't quite time it, but manages to place it far enough to the right of long-on to pick up four and reach his half-century
length ball on leg stump. Anderson stays leg-side of the ball and bunts it into the covers for a single
shortish outside off, slapped to deep point
full on off stump, blocked back towards the bowler
back of a length outside off, dabbed to backward point
a bit more air, floated across towards off stump. Anderson goes down on one knee to swipe that to deep midwicket
fired in flat on the pads, clipped to deep square leg
length ball on the pads, worked away towards deep square leg
tossed up on off stump, clipped to long-on
goes back to another length ball, and this time he manages to swivel powerfully through his hips and pummel that past the bowler, down to the long-on boundary
length ball on off stump, punched to long-off
loopy delivery outside off, flat-bat drive to short extra cover
tossed up outside off. Anderson goes deep in his crease, clubs it down to long-off
tossed up again, swept firmly to deep midwicket
ball. Nice flight, angling in towards middle and leg, the angle opened up Rohit's feet, and then it turned away sharply, beat the outside edge of his prodding bat, and missed off stump
bouncer, angling across Anderson. Had to fetch the pull from outside off, and couldn't put bat to ball
short outside off, steered away to the right of third man. Morkel chases it down, slides to stop it, and throws it back to the keeper while lying on his backside
shortish on off stump, pulled to long-on. Came on quicker than he expected, maybe. May have wanted to hit that more towards midwicket
slower ball on the pads, flicked straight to midwicket
length ball on off stump, stays leg-side of the ball and carves it towards point
slower ball, full outside off, driven to long-off
short, wide, smacked. It sat up to be hit wherever Anderson wanted, and he swivelled through his hips and powered that away to the left of the man at cover
length ball on middle stump, and Rohit clears his front leg to make a bit of room to flick it away towards deep midwicket
shortish outside off, slapped to sweeper cover
length ball floated across Anderson, who steps back, makes a bit of room, and slaps it towards cover
back of a length, turns from middle to leg, semi-punched, semi-pulled to long-on
starts with one angled into the pads, Rohit works it away to the left of deep backward square leg
length ball on off stump, Rohit gets his front foot across to work it away through forward square leg
back of a length on off stump, stays inside the line, gets on his toes, and squirts it away to third man
short and wide, again a bit of low bounce. Anderson looks to cut, the ball sneaks under his bat and bounces through to Uthappa
length ball outside off, dabbed softly towards short third man
shortish, angling into the body. Doesn't get up as high as Rohit expected, and he was also through the pull a little too early, hits him on the stomach
length ball outside off. Rohit comes forward and steers it away towards third man
length ball on off stump, quite slow, no turn. Rohit waits on it and whips it away through square leg
short and wide, and that is easy pickings for Rohit, who slashes hard and pierces the gap between backward point and short third man
fuller now, on middle stump, blocked back towards the bowler
length ball on off stump. Rohit stays on the back foot, it keeps a bit low, and he jams his bat down in a hurry to poke it away towards point
floated up full on off stump, Rohit gets forward to block into the on side
slowish length ball on middle and off, goes with the angle. Anderson stays on the back foot and punches it down the ground towards long-off
back of a length on middle and off, punched away through point
length ball on middle stump, blocked back towards the bowler

this time he gives him a bit of width, and Anderson drives powerfully through extra cover, bringing his wrists into the shot to hit that on the top of the bounce and find the big gap to the right of mid-off
again, that beautiful length. Pitches on off, continues to go away with the angle, and Anderson plays and misses, looking for the drive through mid-off
fullish on middle and off, defended nervously towards mid-off, no footwork at all
back of a length on off stump. Rohit gets on his toes, uses the inward angle to tuck it away towards midwicket
similar delivery, quicker, closer to off and middle. Anderson has to bring his bat down in a hurry to defend
floated up on middle stump, turns like a legbreak. Anderson didn't pick that, got his front pad in the way as he came forward to defend. Polite appeal for lbw, that was clearly going down leg
length ball on off stump, clipped to long-on

short and wide, no turn, slapped firmly and Shakib dives to his right and makes an excellent stop at point. Takes a moment to turn to release the throw to the bowler's end, since he has to transfer the ball to his left hand, and Anderson, who had hared out of his crease, returns home safely
quickish length ball, turns in towards off stump, blocked back to the bowler
starts with a full-toss floated wide outside off, and Rohit plonks his front leg forward and drives it confidently to the cover boundary
along the same angle but a touch shorter this time, Anderson shoulders arms
ball! Angling away from Anderson, on the perfect length to entice the drive. Feet were going nowhere, and the bat swished through the wrong line
fullish, angling away from off stump, left alone
length ball, angling across towards middle and off. Anderson defends into the leg side

Gambhir had two slips in place, and Rayudu has steered this one straight into first slip's hands. Back of a length outside off, left the batsman off the pitch. Simply poked at it with an open face, a nothing shot, and it flew off the outside half of the bat and into Yusuf's palms at a comfortable chest height

that is some Morkel-ish bounce from Morkel. Wasn't particularly short,  outside off,and Rayudu was actually on the front foot. Took off, and he could only tuck his bat behind his pad and leave it alone

down the track now, Tare doesn't reach the pitch, and he picks out that man Umesh again. Shakib tossed it up slower and wider, and Tare had to reach out in front of his body to hit that, ended up hitting it straight down long-off's throat
overcompensates, fires this down the leg side
shortish outside off, slapped hard but straight to point
fired in quicker, into the pads, tucked away through square leg

down the track comes Rohit, gets right to the pitch of this middle-stump ball, and extends his arms fully. You know what happens when Rohit does that. Soars over the bowler's head, over the straight boundary
full on middle and leg, blocked into the on side
fired in round-arm, full, towards off stump. Worked away with the angle through square leg
back of a length on off stump. Tare stands tall and pulls it away towards deep backward square leg
length ball on middle stump, poked to mid-on with soft hands
beauty. On a good length, straightening a touch on a fifth-stump line. Rohit pushes at it and the ball beats his outside edge
width again, fullish length, and this time he slashes with an angled bat and edges it down to third man
once again some width, not as full, and Tare opens his bat face and punches it away into the gap between backward point and cover point
very full, a bit of width outside off, Tare jams his bat down and jabs it away firmly but can't beat cover point
again width outside off. Rohit plays a more flashing, flat-batted drive this time, away from his body, and slices it wide of the diving fielder at point
this one isn't as full. Rohit gets a half-stride out and plays a punchy drive to cover point
gentle, floaty outswinger outside off. Looked like a slower ball. Rohit gets forward and plays a flowing drive between cover point and short extra cover
length ball on off stump, defended back to Umesh
length ball on off and middle. Rohit presses forward to block it back to the bowler
too full, on the pads, and that's a freebie for Rohit, who flicks it in the air, into the vacant square leg region
length ball angling in towards off stump, Rohit uses the angle to clip it to long leg
length ball outside off, left alone
lbw appeal as Rohit pushes his hands in front of his body to drive down the ground, feet going nowhere, and the inward angle cayuses the ball to hit his pad. May have got an inside-edge on that

and that's the first wicket of IPL 2015. It's onto Finch quicker than he expected. He was in an uncomfortable half-forward position, no position from which to pull - it wasn't short enough for that either - and he top-edged it high in the air, simple catch for the man at deep square leg
back of a length, angling into off stump. Finch hops across and tucks it down towards midwicket
starts by angling one into the pads and Finch whips it away to the fine leg boundary
full outswinger, a bit of width outside off. Rohit stretches out to drive, can't beat cover point
back of a length, angling in towards leg stump. Finch shuffles to work it into the leg side, doesn't connect. runs off his pads towards square leg
fullish on off stump, straightens a touch as Rohit looks to push through the covers, no real footwork. Ends up edging thickly to third man
back of a length, angling in towards off and middle. Finch jumps across to tuck it away towards square leg
full on leg stump, clipped off the toes to long leg
it's on a good length close to off stump, and Rohit presses forward to defend towards point
full and wide, and Suryakumar wins it for Knight Riders with a crisp drive to the extra cover boundary
full on off stump, smacked hard to long-on, lots of bottom hand
slower bouncer outside off. Yusuf can't connect with the pull
full outside off, swiped away to the right of long-on
full on off stump, and Suryakumar shuffles across and whips it over the wide long-on boundary. Fifth six of his innings
slower short ball outside off, swatted over the bowler's head, mid-on runs to his right to field it
slower bouncer outside off, Yusuf fails to connect with the pull
short, angled down leg, and Yusuf whips it off his hips and easily beats long leg, who sprints to his right and sprawls full-length in a desperate attempt to stop the ball
slower ball in the blockhole on middle stump, whipped in the air, bounces down towards long-on
short ball outside off, Yusuf uses Bumrah's inward angle and pulls it effortlessly over the midwicket boundary
back of a length outside off, steered down to third man
full-toss on middle and leg, and Suryakumar whips those wrists again, launches it over wide long-on
bouncer, and it hits Suryakumar flush on the side of the helmet as he swivels round to try and hook
width again, but this time the length allows him to get elevation and easily clear the extra cover boundary
full and wide. Suryakumar plays and misses, going for an extravagant drive
looks for the wide yorker, ends up going past the tramline outside off
in the blockhole on leg stump, clipped to long-on
bouncer, angling down leg. Goes for the hook, doesn't connect. Not given wide, even though there was an argument for it both in terms of line and height
back of a length outside off, steered away towards third man
full and wide, slapped firmly to the diving Finch at point
again some away-swerve. Starts from a slightly shorter length, wider outside off, and Yusuf plays and misses, looking to push it into the covers
fullish, a bit of swerve from middle to off. Yusuf defends solidly into the off side
short ball angling into the body, pulled away towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot. Pollard dives to his right from backward point to stop it
length ball outside off, comes forward and works it towards long-on
and again that pick-up shot. It's a length ball, angling in towards off and middle. Gets his front leg across and whips it, goes finer this time, over the head of the long leg fielder
a catch has been taken! It's short, and it gets a bit big on Gambhir as he looks to pull. Had to fetch it from shoulder height, from outside off, and he picked out Rayudu at deep square leg
full, angled across towards middle and off. Gambhir clears his front leg and shovels it over mid-on. Didn't hit it too cleanly, but picked out an unguarded area
length ball outside off, stays back and pulls towards wide long-on
short again, pulled in the air, bounces down to long-on
flat length ball on off stump, whipped away to deep midwicket
shortish, turns from middle to off. Gambhir rocks back and pulls towards long-on

dropped! Again! A bit of flight and Gambhir goes hard at it, looking to hit down the ground. Goes low to Harbhajan's right, and he crouches and gets both hands to hit, but it simply deflects off them and runs away to the boundary to bring up Gambhir's fifty
tossed up outside off, whipped away to long-on
back of a length outside off, dabbed away towards short third man
back of a length outside off. Suryakumar lets it come on and dabs it to the right of the keeper
back of a length on off stump. Gambhir looks to poke it towards point, ends up chopping it down into his feet
length ball outside off, dabbed away to third man
length ball on off stump, and Suryakumar plays the Viv Richards shot. Plonks his front foot across and whips it away over deep square leg
full outside off, driven back firmly to the bowler
tossed up outside off. Pandey goes for the slog-sweep, has to reach out to connect, ends up hitting it much straighter than he intended, straight down the throat (not literally) of Pollard at long-on
length ball on off stump, turns away to accentuate the angle across. Gambhir rocks back to cut it away towards deep point
tossed up outside off, driven to long-off
full on middle stump, gets his front foot out of the way and drives down to long-off
shortish outside off, chopped towards point
full outside off, Pandey gets on the front foot, head over the ball, and uses his wrists to whip it down to long-on
low full-toss on the pads, whipped away to deep square leg
in the blockhole on middle and leg, clipped to the left of Rohit at short midwicket
full-toss outside off. Gambhir goes hard at the drive, ends up playing down the wrong line. Outside edge, but it bounces down on its way to the keeper
another slower ball, turns in from off to middle. Pandey waits on it and tucks it away through square leg
waist-high full-toss down the leg side, and Pandey flicks his wrists and whips it away over the deep backward square leg boundary. Effortless
slower ball on middle and leg, Pandey checks his attempted clip to make sure it drops short of midwicket

short and wide once more, and that is brilliant placement from Gambhir again. A sure-footed step back and across and a jab to place it to the left of point and far enough to the right of sweeper cover to pick up another boundary
sees a bit of air, skips down the track nimbly, gets inside the line, and chips this leg-stump ball inside-out, over extra cover, and Pollard, sprinting to his right from long-off, has no chance
fuller now, driven to long-off
back of a length on off stump, punched into the covers
back of a length outside off, dabbed away backward of point

shortish outside off, and Pandey launches it down the ground, looking to clear long-off. Anderson completely misjudges it, comes in too far off the rope, ends up having to leap in the air and reach overhead, one-handed, and can't hold on. I've lost count of the dropped catches today
length ball on middle stump, flat, goes on the back foot and works it with the turn towards deep backward square leg
length ball on off stump, goes on the back foot and tucks it into the midwicket region
overpitched on middle and leg, clipped through square leg
tossed up outside off, driven to long-off
shot! That is barely a short ball, but Pandey is on the back foot in a flash, and swivels through his hips to launch that high over deep square leg
back of a length outside off, leans back and dabs it to the right of short third man
tossed up full on leg stump, clipped away to deep square leg
full on middle and leg, punched back to the bowler
short, plenty of width, and Gambhir leans back and plays a precise cut to the left of point, times it beautifully and gives sweeper cover no chance of cutting it off
tossed up, angled across Gambhir, who looks for the drive through cover, too much bottom hand on it, and he inside-edges it narrowly past his off stump
short on off stump now. Gambhir rocks back, makes room, and cuts it away to the left of third man
starts with a full ball wide outside off, and Gambhir gets a massive stride forward to cream a drive through the covers
flat and short on middle and off, pulled away to deep midwicket
length ball on off stump, pushed off the back foot towards long-on
length ball angling away from off stump, chopped away towards backward point
a bit of air, and Gambhir is down the track in a flash to swing it away, with the turn, over the midwicket boundary
shortish outside off, cut away towards third man
flat, angled across towards off stump. Looks to make room to cut, can only chop it down feebly into the off side
length ball, straightens a bit and cramps Gambhir as he tries to chop a middle-stump ball square on the off side. Ends up inside-edging it into the pitch, near his feet
length ball on middle and leg, looks to tuck it into the leg side, hits it too close to the bowler
length ball angled across Gambhir, steered to short third man
shortish, angling in towards middle and leg. Pandey tucks it off his hips, and hits it straight to short fine leg. A few feet either way, that was four
short outside off, doesn't come on. Looks to cut, ends up hitting too early, dragging it off the bottom of his bat to cover
and here's Manish Pandey. It's shortish, wide, and it sits up outside off. Pandey is on the front foot, and he flat-bats it crisply to the cover boundary

Gautam Gambhir, what are you doing? Didn't have too much idea of what this ball was going to do. It was on a good length, around off stump, and he poked at it with an open-faced, angled bat, playing for swing. Kept going with the angle and narrowly beat his inside edge
in the blockhole on off stump, jabbed to mid-on
fullish on middle stump, a bit of swing, clipped away through square leg
full inswinger, and Pandey looks to whip through the leg side. Too quickly into his shot and the leading edge pops into the air on the off side, runs away for four to the right of third man

full outside off, and that's an interesting shot from Pandey. Goes down on one knee, clears his front leg, and ends up clearing the straight boundary with what could possibly be described as a slog-sweep over the bowler's head
very full, wide outside off, left alone
short and wide, slapped away but can't beat the diving Finch at cover
back of a length, a bit of swing in to cramp Gambhir for room. Stays leg-side of the ball and bunts it towards backward point
down the track, heaves across the line looking to go over midwicket. The ball was slanting away from him all the time and he was nowhere near connecting
fullish outside off, good stride forward to push into the covers
back of a length on leg stump, tucked away through square leg
short ball on leg stump, and it only gets up to waist height. Easily pulled away to the backward square leg boundary
ooh. Swing again, lots of it, and it started from outside off. Pandey's feet were going nowhere as he poked at it, looking to play into the covers, and it curled in sharply and beat his inside edge

gone! This was full, slanted across a bit wider, and Uthappa went for the drive. Was playing away from the body, with an angled bat, and the edge carried through to slip at a comfortable height, just over the head
length ball outside off, and Gambhir comes forward and picks up the 75318394552th poked single to point of his life

was that another drop? Looked like it. Swung into Uthappa again as he came forward to drive. May have been looking to go through mid-off, ended up hitting it back towards the bowler, low to his right. Dived and got his right hand to it but it simply didn't stick
ball. Good length this time, angled across. Uthappa plays for the swing, looking to push towards mid-off, but it holds its line and beats his outside edge

Wow. Just a little pick-up shot, and it's carried all the way over the square leg boundary. It was full from Anderson, and it swung into Uthappa's pads, and it only took him a flick of the wrists to pick up six runs
dropped. No. 4 on the night. This is short of a length, on off, he opens the face as it angles across him, edges it low to Tare's left, but he can't hold on despite the dive
this time he takes on the arm of Rohit Sharma at mid-off, and completes an easy single
short of a length, no room, defended to mid-off
gets a leading edge first ball but it doesn't carry to mid-off
stays in the crease this time. Lets the ball come on this time and opens the face for a single to third man

Pace like fire. Vinay Kumar, captain of double treble in Indian domestic cricket, has broken Gambhir's bat. That will teach him to charge at him. Gambhir jumps out of the crease, looks to hit hard, but is left only with his handle in the hand as the ball hits the shoulder of it
short of a length, on off, punched to mid-off. Another dot
this one starts around middle and off, and shapes away towards off. Uthappa defends towards mid-on. Bowled at 147ks
movement away again, beats the defensive bat of Uthappa
short of a length, outside off, slight shape away, defended with an open face
swing again, beats the inside edge, goes for a leg-bye
more swing but this time he starts too straight and concedes a wide down the leg side
a bit of swing, around off, Uthappa defends, and the ball runs off the inside half of the bat for one
